name: Ruin Meadow
description: Emerald meadow grass that grew over the paved streets of a dead city.
role: The base ground of the Overgrown Ruins.

artBrief.spriteScale: Seamless square tile. Floor entities tile it over a 4×4 cell footprint.
artBrief.silhouette: Flat tile of soft grass clumps.
artBrief.detail: Three greens layered in clumps, with pale mint highlights.
artBrief.readability: Low contrast; it sits under everything.
